brief:
Israeli occupation forces violated the Gaza ceasefire early Monday through sustained military operations across multiple areas of the territory, Shehab Wire reported. The violations included airstrikes, artillery bombardment, and gunfire targeting different zones. Military vehicles also conducted maneuvers in the region while illumination bombs were deployed throughout the night.

The incidents represent a fresh escalation in breaches of the agreed ceasefire arrangement. The violations occurred as the territory faces ongoing tensions following the broader conflict in the region.
